parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, small in size, and designed to be pressed by the user.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the release of liquid from the dispenser when pressed, allowing measured dispensing of the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or elastic mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section connects the pressing lid to the base body, made of durable plastic, and houses the internal pump mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the base body to the pressing lid and provides structural support for the dispensing mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but allows internal fluid movement through the pump system.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, cylindrical in shape, made of polyethylene plastic, and designed to hold liquid soap or detergent.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid to be dispensed and provides a stable base for the entire structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and does not move relative to other parts.
